description_en: Queries the list of resource instances that belong to a cost center of the user. When CostCenterId is 0, it queries unallocated primary and sub-resource instances
description_zh: 查询用户的财务单元所属的资源实例列表。当 CostCenterId 为 0，表示查未分配的主子资源实例
name: QueryCostCenterResource

parameters.help_en: The owner user ID of the cost center
parameters.name: owner_account_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cost center
parameters.name: cost_center_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query. An empty NextToken indicates that there are no more results
parameters.help_zh: 下一个查询开始Token，NextToken为空说明没有下一个
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records per query
parameters.help_zh: 单次查询的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The list of accessed accounts. An empty value indicates that all accounts under the current entity ID are selected
fields.help_zh: 访问的账号列表，为空代表全选当前实体ID下所有账号
fields.name: account_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of enterprises and accounts. An empty value indicates querying the current account
parameters.help_zh: 企业与账号列表，为空表示查询当前账号自身
parameters.name: ec_id_account_ids

parameters.help_en: The first-level marketplace ID. If empty, the marketplace ID of the current user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 一级售卖场ID，如果为空，默认使用当前用户所属的场ID填充
parameters.name: nbid
